The '''2018–19 [[Super League Greece]]''', or ''Super League Souroti'' for sponsorship reasons,<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.novasports.gr/podosfairo/ellada/super-league/article/332104/perase-i-horigia-souroti-souper-lig|title=Πέρασε η χορηγία, "Σουρωτή Σούπερ Λιγκ"|website=novasports.gr|date=23 June 2017|archive-date=12 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180612142121/http://www.novasports.gr/podosfairo/ellada/super-league/article/332104/perase-i-horigia-souroti-souper-lig|url-status=dead}}</ref> was the 83rd season of the highest tier in league of [[Football in Greece|Greek]] [[Association football|football]] and the 13th under its current name. The season started on 25 August 2018 and concluded on 22 May 2019 with the relegation play-offs.

[[AEK Athens F.C.|AEK Athens]] were the defending champions. [[OFI Crete F.C.|OFI]] and [[Aris Thessaloniki F.C.|Aris]] joined as the promoted clubs from the [[2017–18 Football League (Greece)|2017–18 Football League]],<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.novasports.gr/podosfairo/ellada/football-league/article/380562/sti-souper-lig-ofi-kai-aris-/|title=Στη Σούπερ Λιγκ ΟΦΗ και Άρης!|website=novasports.gr|date=29 April 2018|lang=el}}</ref> replacing [[Platanias F.C.|Platanias]] and [[PAE Kerkyra|Kerkyra]] who were relegated to the [[2018–19 Football League (Greece)|2018–19 Football League]].

[[PAOK FC|PAOK]] won their third championship and their first in 34 years, by defeating [[Levadiakos F.C.|Levadiakos]] on the penultimate matchday. They also managed to finish the season unbeaten, becoming the second club in Greek top-tier history to do so after Panathinaikos in the [[1963–64 Alpha Ethniki|1963–64 season]].

[[PAS Giannina F.C.|PAS Giannina]], [[Levadiakos F.C.|Levadiakos]] and [[Apollon Smyrnis F.C.|Apollon Smyrnis]] finished in the bottom 3 and were relegated to Super League 2, while [[OFI Crete F.C.|OFI]], who finished 13th, faced [[Platanias F.C.|Platanias]] who were runners-up of the [[2018–19_Football_League_(Greece)|2018–19 Football League]] in the relegation play-offs on May 19 and May 22 for a place in the [[2019–20 Super League Greece|2019–20 Super League]]. OFI won the play-offs 3–2 on aggregate.

This was the last season with a 16-team championship. From the 2019–20 season, the league teams were reduced to 14, and a playoff tournament was introduced between the first six teams of the regular season, for a total of 36 games, in the style of the [[Cypriot First Division]]. Three teams relegated directly instead of the usual two and a fourth spot was decided between the 13th placed Super League team and the runner-up of the [[2018–19 Football League (Greece)|2018–19 Football League]]. The fourth spot was a cause of controversy between the Super League and the HFF, however, the sporting court decided in favour of the play-off match in order to not completely diminish the chance for the second division runners-up to be promoted, as they would normally be promoted automatically in a normal season.

==Teams==
Sixteen teams competed in the league – the top fourteen teams from the previous season, and two teams promoted from the [[Football League (Greece)|Football League]].

The first club to be promoted was [[OFI Crete F.C.|OFI]], after beating 1–0 [[Apollon Kalamarias F.C.|Apollon Pontus]] on 29 April 2018. OFI would play in the Super League for the first time since the [[2014–15 Super League Greece|2014–15]] season. The second and final club to be promoted was [[Aris Thessaloniki F.C.|Aris]], after beating 2–0 [[A.E. Karaiskakis F.C.|Karaiskakis]] on 29 April 2018. Aris would play in the Super League for the first time since the [[2013–14 Super League Greece|2013–14]] season.

The first club to be relegated was [[Platanias F.C.|Platanias]], who were relegated on 4 April 2018 following [[Apollon Smyrnis F.C.|Apollon Smyrnis]]' 1–0 victory against [[PAS Giannina F.C.|PAS Giannina]], ending their 6-year stay in the top flight. The second and final club to be relegated was [[PAE Kerkyra|Kerkyra]], who were relegated on 29 April 2018 following [[PAS Lamia 1964|Lamia]]'s 2–1 victory against [[PAS Giannina F.C.|PAS Giannina]], ending their 2-year stay in the top flight.
